'''Dorailla''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].

==Strength and Abilities==
Dorailla can [[channel]] quite strongly. In TWoTC her strength level is described as {{opsl|21}}, the same level of [[Myrelle]] and [[Anaiya]], that are among the strongest [[Aes Sedai]] until the arrive of [[Nynaeve]], [[Egwene]] and [[Elayne]].

This strength is more than enough to open alone a gateway for [[Travel]]ing. 

== Activities ==
She takes part in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] with [[Sevanna]]. She is one of the [[Wise Ones]] who attack the [[Aes Sedai]] who are holding [[Rand al'Thor]]. She was "Chosen from the strongest of the Shaido Wise Ones who could wield the One Power".
